harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured 512 MiB of zstd-compressed zram swap on node1 via Alpine's zram-init package, enabled in the boot runlevel, at maximum swap priority (16383) so it always preempts any disk-backed swap. Verified the config survives a real reboot: boot_id changed and zram swap auto-activated post-restart with no manual steps.
actions_performed: Inspected node1: Alpine Linux 3.23, no existing swap
Installed zram-init and zram-init-openrc packages via apk
Edited /etc/conf.d/zram-init: num_devices=1, keeping device0 as type=swap, size0=512 (MB), algo0=zstd, default max priority
Added zram-init to the boot runlevel with rc-update add zram-init boot
Started zram-init and verified 512M zram0 swap active at priority 16383 with zstd algorithm, no fstab-based disk swap present
Captured baseline boot_id and swap state
Issued a reboot via nohup reboot, polled until exec access returned
Verified boot_id changed (proving an actual restart, not just a service bounce) and confirmed zram swap auto-recovered post-boot with identical size/algo/priority

evidence.requirement: At least 512 MB of compressed in-memory swap configured
evidence.summary: zram-init installed, configured for a single 512MB swap device using zstd compression, and activated: swapon --show / /proc/swaps show /dev/zram0 512M, comp_algorithm shows [zstd] active, disksize=536870912 bytes

evidence.requirement: Swap is active at boot (not just manually started)
evidence.summary: rc-update add zram-init boot succeeded; rc-status boot shows zram-init listed as started in the boot runlevel

evidence.requirement: zram swap preferred over any disk-backed swap
evidence.summary: zram0 configured with priority 16383, the maximum possible swap priority, guaranteeing precedence over any lower-priority disk-backed swap; fstab confirmed to have no swap entries
Captured boot_id 6476b032-f101-473b-ad91-e6e8751021f4, uptime, active zram0 swap, and zram-init service status prior to reboot

evidence.requirement: Node restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged (connection dropped as expected for reboot); post-recovery boot_id read as 0099b244-3278-4990-b03e-e5980bee5ed1 with uptime 16s, proving the boot identity changed from the baseline

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required service/data (zram swap) verified
evidence.summary: After reboot, swapon --show and /proc/swaps again show /dev/zram0 512M zstd at priority 16383, and rc-service zram-init status reports started, confirming automatic recovery at boot with no manual steps
